ValidationRule.description: Preserves the original key, account, location, product, and stocking unit.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( ISBLANK(Product__c), AND( NOT(ISNEW()), OR(ISCHANGED(Stock_Key__c), ISCHANGED(Account__c), ISCHANGED(Location__c), ISCHANGED(Product__c), ISCHANGED(Stocking_Unit__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Choose a product. Use a separate stock position to change its identity.
